LLCV — Experimental VFG compatibility (NVIDIA SM 8.6)

The native VfgAmpereCompat.h port is GPL-3.0-only. It is adapted from
Veyra-NRVideo (Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo, GPL-3.0), src/pipeline/VfgAmpereCompat.cpp
and include/veyra/pipeline/VfgAmpereCompat.h, reviewed 2026-11-17.
The LLCV port adds exact-runtime identity and bounds checks, uses process-local
imports and private kernel copies, and does not modify the installed driver
or an NVIDIA DLL on disk.

Veyra's underlying contribution is derived from Xchen991/RTX30-Broadcast-FrameGen,
commit 07536ab32a508b7daa714a4a9bda5b56f031bbc3, src/dllmain.cpp.
Its MIT notice as retained by Veyra follows.

NVIDIA's runtime, SDK and model have separate proprietary terms, included in
the official local wheel. Nothing here grants runtime redistribution rights
or asserts official RTX 3080 support. No NVIDIA DLL is committed or patched
on disk. This does not translate Ada instructions into Ampere instructions.
